text: 周五（8月7日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率跌3.24个基点，报4.6454%，北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告时从4.6678%跳水、20:47刷新日低至4.6007%，本周累计下跌8.93%，8月4日跌幅突出。 两年期美债收益率跌5.02个基点，报4.1952%，非农就业报告出炉时从4.2306%跳水、20:40刷新日低至4.1515%，本周累跌9.59个基点。
text_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 7), the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield fell 3.24 basis points to 4.6454%. When the US nonfarm payroll report was released at 20:30 Beijing time, it plunged from 4.6678%, hitting a session low of 4.6007% at 20:47. It fell 8.93% for the week, with August 4 seeing a notable decline. The 2-year Treasury yield dropped 5.02 basis points to 4.1952%, plunging from 4.2306% when the payroll report was released, and hitting a session low of 4.1515% at 20:40. It was down 9.59 basis points for the week.
